units.source_text: 本因坊秀哉名人三十余年不曾执过黑子。

en.t: For more than thirty years, Honinbo Shusai, the Master, had never played with the black stones.

units.source_text: 他是第一高手，没有第二个人可以与之匹敌。

en.t: He was the foremost master, and no one else could rival him.

units.source_text: 在名人生前，没有别人进入过八段。

en.t: During the Master's lifetime, no one else had reached the rank of eighth dan.

units.source_text: 他把同时代的对手完全压倒，下一代没有人能够达到他的地位。

en.t: He completely overwhelmed the opponents of his own era, and no one in the next generation could attain his standing.

units.source_text: 名人作古十年后的今天，围棋方面尚未找到什么途径能够继任名人的地位。

en.t: Even today, ten years after the Master's death, the world of go has still found no way for anyone to inherit the Master's position.

units.source_text: 其原因之一，恐怕是秀哉名人的名声太大吧。

en.t: One reason for this was probably that Master Shusai's reputation was simply too great.

units.source_text: 尊重棋道传统的“名人”，大约在这一代之后就告终了。

en.t: The title of Master, in the sense of one who honored the traditions of the way of go, probably came to an end with that generation.
